caption: The drawing contains two distinct objects, both rendered in shades of yellow, gold, and brown on a plain beige background. The object at the top is a rectangular band, segmented into several sections, each decorated with repeating raised floral or botanical motifs, bordered by vertical dividers, and colored primarily in gold and yellow hues with areas of brown shading. The object below is a circular open bracelet or collar, comprised of connected segments that mimic organic, possibly leaf-like forms, also rendered in gold and yellow tones with subtle brown accents; attached to this circular form is a delicate chain, drawn in a fine gold line, which hangs downward in a curve. The drawing is labeled at the bottom left with the text "Westchester County" and at the bottom right with “Drawn by Wm Shearwood.”
title: Bracelet
